claims.claim: Modularity compares observed within-community links to a configuration-model null expectation.
claims.locator: Newman & Girvan (2004), community evaluation and modularity equation

claims.claim: For two triangles joined by one bridge, the two-part partition has modularity 5/14 and the single-community partition has modularity zero.
claims.locator: Derived from 7 edges, 3 edges within each part and total degree 7 per part

claims.claim: Girvan–Newman iteratively removes high edge-betweenness links to expose divisive communities.
Louvain performs local modularity optimization followed by aggregation.
Modularity optimization can merge smaller communities because of an intrinsic resolution limit.
claims.locator: Fortunato & Barthélemy (2007), Resolution Limit in Community Detection

claims.claim: Leiden improves guarantees related to badly connected Louvain communities.
claims.locator: Traag, Waltman & van Eck (2019), Leiden algorithm
